comment: 批次四（R3-7）：听力三题型补篇至各 4 篇。保留原有 news/longconv/passage 三篇，新增 news_1~news_3 / longconv_1~longconv_3 / passage_1~passage_3 共 9 篇。结构沿用 voiceplayer.js 的 SCENES：t + lines[{en,zh}]。新增 key 采用 _N 后缀，避免与内置 news/longconv/passage 离线兜底场景冲突（loadListeningExt 对已存在 key 不覆盖）。

news.t: 短篇新闻 · 校园节能倡议

lines.en: A new green-energy plan was launched at the university this week.
lines.zh: 本周这所大学启动了一项新的绿色能源计划。

lines.en: The school will replace old lights with smart LEDs in all classrooms.
lines.zh: 学校将把所有教室的旧灯具更换为智能 LED 灯。

lines.en: Students are asked to turn off unused devices before leaving the lab.
lines.zh: 学校呼吁学生在离开实验室前关闭未使用的设备。

lines.en: Officials say the change may cut electricity use by about twenty percent.
lines.zh: 校方表示，这一改变可使用电量降低约百分之二十。

lines.en: A student club will check the results and share a monthly report.
lines.zh: 一个学生社团将核查成效并发布月度报告。

lines.en: The plan will run for one term as a trial before a wider rollout.
lines.zh: 该计划先试行一个学期，之后再考虑全面推广。

longconv.t: 长对话 · 求职面试约时间

lines.en: A: Hello, this is the hiring team. May I speak with Miss Lin?
lines.zh: A：您好，这里是招聘组，请问能找林女士听电话吗？

lines.en: B: Speaking. Thanks for calling me about the interview.
lines.zh: B：我就是。谢谢您打来通知我面试的事。

lines.en: A: We would like to meet you next Tuesday at ten in the morning.
lines.zh: A：我们想约您下周二上午十点见面。

lines.en: B: Tuesday at ten works for me. Where should I go?
lines.zh: B：周二上午十点可以，我该去哪里？

lines.en: A: Please come to Room 305 on the third floor of the office building.
lines.zh: A：请到办公楼三楼 305 室。

lines.en: B: Got it. Should I bring my resume and a notebook?
lines.zh: B：明白了。我需要带简历和笔记本吗？

lines.en: A: Yes, and a copy of your certificate would be helpful too.
lines.zh: A：要的，另外带上一份证书复印件也会有帮助。

lines.en: B: Sure, I will arrive ten minutes early. See you then.
lines.zh: B：好的，我会提前十分钟到，到时见。

passage.t: 篇章理解 · 时间管理的两个习惯

lines.en: Good time management is not about doing more, but doing what matters.
lines.zh: 良好的时间管理不在于做更多事，而在于做重要的事。

lines.en: First, write down the three most important tasks the night before.
lines.zh: 首先，在前一晚写下三件最重要的事。

lines.en: This helps your brain focus before the busy day begins.
lines.zh: 这能让大脑在忙碌的一天开始前就聚焦重点。

lines.en: Second, group small jobs together and finish them in one short block.
lines.zh: 其次，把零碎的小事集中起来，用一小段时间一并处理。

lines.en: Checking email only twice a day can save a lot of lost attention.
lines.zh: 每天只在两个固定时段查邮件，能省下大量被分散的注意力。

lines.en: Many students find they feel calmer and finish earlier with this method.
lines.zh: 许多学生发现，用这个方法后他们更从容，也能更早完成任务。

lines.en: The key is to plan, then protect your focus from small interruptions.
lines.zh: 关键在于先规划，再保护自己的专注不被小事打断。

lines.en: Try it for one week and see if your week feels more in your control.
lines.zh: 试上一个星期，看看这一周是否更在你的掌控之中。

news_1.t: 短篇新闻 · 科技简讯：校园学习助手

lines.en: A new study app was introduced at the city college on Monday.
lines.zh: 本市学院于周一上线了一款新的学习应用。

lines.en: The app uses simple AI to answer questions about course materials.
lines.zh: 该应用借助简易人工智能，回答与课程材料相关的问题。

lines.en: Students can ask it for summaries, examples and short quizzes.
lines.zh: 学生可以向它索要摘要、例句和简短测验。

lines.en: Developers say it was built by a team of six students and two teachers.
lines.zh: 开发者称，它由一个六名学生和两名教师组成的团队打造。

lines.en: The service is free and runs on both phones and laptops.
lines.zh: 该服务免费，手机和笔记本电脑都能使用。

lines.en: Testers report that it saves them about one hour of study each day.
lines.zh: 试用者反映，它每天能为他们节省约一小时的学习时间。

lines.en: The team plans to add a voice function later this term.
lines.zh: 团队计划在本学期晚些时候加入语音功能。

news_2.t: 短篇新闻 · 交通：城市夜间公交

lines.en: The city opened two new night bus lines last weekend.
lines.zh: 本市上周末新开通了两条夜间公交线路。

lines.en: The buses run every twenty minutes from ten at night to five in the morning.
lines.zh: 这些公交车从晚上十点到凌晨五点，每隔二十分钟一班。

lines.en: They connect the train station with the main university campus.
lines.zh: 它们把火车站与大学主校区连接起来。

lines.en: Officials hope the service will make late travel safer and cheaper.
lines.zh: 有关部门希望这项服务能让夜间出行更安全、更省钱。

lines.en: Tickets cost just two yuan, and students pay half price.
lines.zh: 车票仅需两元，学生还可享受半价。

lines.en: More than three thousand people used the lines on the first night.
lines.zh: 开通首晚就有三千多人乘坐了这些线路。

lines.en: If it proves popular, four more lines may open next year.
lines.zh: 如果反响良好，明年可能会再开四条线路。

news_3.t: 短篇新闻 · 招聘：春季校园招聘会

lines.en: The university will hold its spring job fair this Thursday.
lines.zh: 这所大学将于本周四举办春季招聘会。

lines.en: More than one hundred companies will take part in the event.
lines.zh: 超过一百家公司将参加此次活动。

lines.en: They are looking for students in engineering, business and design.
lines.zh: 他们正在招募工程、商科和设计专业的学生。

lines.en: Some firms offer summer internships as well as full-time jobs.
lines.zh: 一些公司既提供暑期实习，也提供全职岗位。

lines.en: Students should bring printed resumes and their student cards.
lines.zh: 学生应携带纸质简历和学生证。

lines.en: A short talk on interview skills will start at nine in the morning.
lines.zh: 上午九点将有一场关于面试技巧的简短讲座。

lines.en: The fair lasts until four in the afternoon in the sports hall.
lines.zh: 招聘会将在体育馆持续到下午四点。

lines.en: A: Excuse me, may I ask you about choosing courses for next term?
lines.zh: A：打扰一下，我能请教一下下学期选课的事吗？

lines.en: B: Of course. What are you thinking about?
lines.zh: B：当然可以，你有什么想法？

lines.en: A: I am not sure whether to take the advanced writing course.
lines.zh: A：我不确定要不要选高级写作课。

lines.en: B: That course is useful, but it needs a lot of reading each week.
lines.zh: B：那门课很有用，但每周需要大量阅读。

lines.en: A: Really? How many hours should I expect to spend on it?
lines.zh: A：真的吗？那预计每周要花多少小时？

lines.en: B: About six to eight hours, including the weekly essay.
lines.zh: B：大约六到八小时，还包括每周一篇作文。

lines.en: A: Then maybe I should take it in my senior year instead.
lines.zh: A：那也许我该把它放到大四再修。

lines.en: B: That is a wise choice. You will write better with more experience.
lines.zh: B：这个选择很明智，经验更丰富时你会写得更好。

lines.en: A: Good morning. I saw your ad for a room near the campus.
lines.zh: A：早上好，我看到了你们校园附近那间房的招租广告。

lines.en: B: Yes, it is still available. It is a small but bright room.
lines.zh: B：是的，房子还在。房间不大，但采光很好。

lines.en: A: How much is the rent, and does it include the bills?
lines.zh: A：租金是多少？包含水电等费用吗？

lines.en: B: Eight hundred a month, and water and heating are included.
lines.zh: B：每月八百，水电和取暖费包含在内。

lines.en: A: That sounds fair. Is the internet fast enough for online classes?
lines.zh: A：听起来挺合理。网速够上线上课用吗？

lines.en: B: Yes, many students here take online lessons without problems.
lines.zh: B：够的，这里很多学生上网课都没问题。

lines.en: A: Great. Could I visit the room this Saturday afternoon?
lines.zh: A：太好了。我周六下午能来看房吗？

lines.en: B: Sure, come after two, and I will show you around.
lines.zh: B：可以，两点以后来，我带你看看。

longconv_3.t: 长对话 · 假期旅行计划

lines.en: A: Have you decided where to go for the long holiday?
lines.zh: A：长假你决定去哪儿了吗？

lines.en: B: Not yet. I want somewhere quiet, not too far or too costly.
lines.zh: B：还没有。我想找个清静的地方，不太远也不太贵。

lines.en: A: How about the old town by the lake? The scenery is lovely in spring.
lines.zh: A：去湖边那座古镇怎么样？春天风景很美。

lines.en: B: That sounds nice. How do we get there?
lines.zh: B：听起来不错，我们怎么去呢？

lines.en: A: We can take the morning train and arrive before noon.
lines.zh: A：我们可以坐早班火车，中午之前就能到。

lines.en: B: And where can we stay? I prefer a small guesthouse.
lines.zh: B：那住哪儿？我更喜欢小旅馆。

lines.en: A: I know one near the river. It is cheap and the host is friendly.
lines.zh: A：我知道河边有一家，价格实惠，老板也很热情。

lines.en: B: Perfect. Let us book the train and the room tonight.
lines.zh: B：完美。今晚我们就把火车票和房间订了吧。

passage_1.t: 篇章理解 · 一位乡村教师

lines.en: Mrs. Wang has taught in a small village school for almost thirty years.
lines.zh: 王老师在一所乡村小学教书已将近三十年。

lines.en: When she arrived, the school had only two rooms and no library.
lines.zh: 她刚来时，学校只有两间教室，也没有图书馆。

lines.en: Over the years, she raised money to build a reading room for the children.
lines.zh: 多年来，她筹款为孩子们建起了一间阅览室。

lines.en: Many of her students went on to study at good universities.
lines.zh: 她的许多学生后来都考上了名牌大学。

lines.en: She often says that every child can shine if given a real chance.
lines.zh: 她常说，只要给予真正的机会，每个孩子都能发光。

lines.en: Even now, she walks to school early and greets each student by name.
lines.zh: 时至今日，她仍早早步行到校，叫得出每个学生的名字。

lines.en: Her quiet work has changed a whole village.
lines.zh: 她默默的工作改变了一整个村庄。

passage_2.t: 篇章理解 · 睡眠与记忆

lines.en: Sleep is not just a time for your body to rest.
lines.zh: 睡眠不只是身体休息的时间。

lines.en: During deep sleep, the brain sorts and stores what you learned that day.
lines.zh: 在深度睡眠中，大脑会整理并储存你当天的所学。

lines.en: That is why a good night's sleep helps you remember new words.
lines.zh: 正因如此，睡个好觉能帮你记住新单词。

lines.en: Scientists found that students who slept well scored higher in tests.
lines.zh: 科学家发现，睡眠好的学生在考试中得分更高。

lines.en: To sleep better, avoid bright screens an hour before bed.
lines.zh: 想睡得更好，睡前一小时应避开明亮的屏幕。

lines.en: Keeping a regular bedtime also makes falling asleep easier.
lines.zh: 保持固定的就寝时间也有助于入睡。

lines.en: So study hard, but do not trade your sleep for extra hours.
lines.zh: 所以努力学习，但别用睡眠去换那几小时。

passage_3.t: 篇章理解 · 中秋节的团圆

lines.en: The Mid-Autumn Festival is one of the most important holidays in China.
lines.zh: 中秋节是中国最重要的节日之一。

lines.en: It falls on the fifteenth day of the eighth lunar month.
lines.zh: 它在农历八月十五这一天。

lines.en: On that night, the moon is at its fullest and brightest.
lines.zh: 那天夜里，月亮最圆最亮。

lines.en: Families gather to share a meal and eat mooncakes together.
lines.zh: 家人团聚，一起吃饭、吃月饼。

lines.en: Mooncakes are round, a symbol of reunion and completeness.
lines.zh: 月饼是圆的，象征团圆和圆满。

lines.en: Children love to hear the old story of Chang'e and the moon.
lines.zh: 孩子们喜欢听嫦娥奔月的古老故事。

lines.en: No matter how far people live, they try to come home for this day.
lines.zh: 无论人们住得多远，都会尽量在这一天回家。
